domains.label: Organizational Structure & People
domains.description: Who exists in the organization, how is it structured, who can do what, and who is accountable for what?

domains.label: Strategy
domains.description: Why is the organization investing, prioritizing and changing?

domains.label: Market
domains.description: What external signals, segments, competitors and customer needs should influence decisions?

domains.label: Product
domains.description: What value does the organization offer, and what product capabilities should change?

domains.label: Commercial
domains.description: How does the organization package, sell, agree, monetize and renew product value?

domains.label: Software Estate
domains.description: What technical systems, components, code, data and infrastructure realize products and run the organization?

domains.label: Delivery
domains.description: How do changes become tested, releasable and deployed results?

domains.label: Operations
domains.description: What is running, how healthy is it, what happened in production, and how does feedback return?

domains.label: Governance
domains.description: What rules, controls, risks, evidence and decisions constrain and assure the organization?

domains.label: External Dependencies
domains.description: Which external parties, supplier agreements, components, licenses, services and obligations does the organization depend on?

domains.label: Work Management Layer
domains.description: How does the organization organize work across all domains?

blocks.label: Organization Boundary
blocks.meaning: Company, legal and structural boundary of the organization being modeled.

blocks.label: People, Employment & Competencies
blocks.meaning: People known to the organization, their employment relationship and what they can do — capabilities, strengths, expertise.

blocks.label: Positions & Reporting
blocks.meaning: Formal role slots and reporting structure.

blocks.label: Teams & Membership
blocks.meaning: Stable teams and the way people or positions are allocated to them.

blocks.label: Responsibility & Measurement
blocks.meaning: Accountability assignments and organizational measurements.

blocks.label: Strategic Direction
blocks.meaning: Long-term intent and choices about where the organization is going.

blocks.label: Objectives & Investment
blocks.meaning: Outcomes, initiatives and investment choices that translate strategy into focus.

blocks.label: Investment Budget & Spend
blocks.meaning: Funding envelopes and actual spend — the financial contour of strategy, not a full finance model.

blocks.label: Roadmaps
blocks.meaning: Planning views that connect strategic intent to planned product, platform or organizational change.

blocks.label: Strategic Decisions
blocks.meaning: Recorded business choices about investment, market, budget, pricing, partnership or priority.

blocks.label: Market Context
blocks.meaning: External arena, target segments and personas used to reason about demand.

blocks.label: Competition
blocks.meaning: Competitors, their products and observed competitive capabilities.

blocks.label: Signals & Evidence
blocks.meaning: External and customer evidence interpreted into product, market or strategy learning.

blocks.label: Market Measurement
blocks.meaning: Measurement of demand, market behavior, competition and segments.

blocks.label: Product Line
blocks.meaning: Optional grouping of related Products; may be absent in smaller or simpler product organizations.

blocks.label: Product
blocks.meaning: Managed offering that delivers value to internal or external customers.

blocks.label: Product Discovery
blocks.meaning: Learning about opportunities, assumptions and experiments before or during product change.

blocks.label: Product Specification
blocks.meaning: Requirements and bounded product changes that can be planned, implemented and verified.

blocks.label: Product Outcomes
blocks.meaning: Expected and measured product results.

blocks.label: Product Actors
blocks.meaning: People, customers and actors who receive value from or interact with a Product.

blocks.label: Product Decisions
blocks.meaning: Recorded choices about product direction, scope, trade-offs and prioritization.

blocks.label: Customer Agreements
blocks.meaning: Commercial customer context and agreements.

blocks.label: Sales Pipeline
blocks.meaning: Sales opportunities moving toward customer agreements.

blocks.label: Packaging & Entitlements
blocks.meaning: How product value is packaged, priced, licensed and granted.

blocks.label: Subscription & Renewal
blocks.meaning: Ongoing commercial access and lifecycle of the paid relationship.

blocks.label: Commercial Commitments
blocks.meaning: Commitments made to customers as part of agreements.

blocks.label: Customer Support & Relationship Health
blocks.meaning: Customer support operations and relationship health.

blocks.label: Usage & Commercial Measurement
blocks.meaning: Measured usage and commercial performance.

blocks.label: Systems & Components
blocks.meaning: Technical systems and components that realize products or internal platforms.

blocks.label: Source & Code
blocks.meaning: Source-control and code organization.

blocks.label: Data Estate
blocks.meaning: Managed data structures and data resources used by products and systems.

blocks.label: Infrastructure & Environments
blocks.meaning: Runtime infrastructure and deployment contexts.

blocks.label: Tooling & Technology Stack
blocks.meaning: Tooling systems and technology stack used to plan, build, run, support and govern work.

blocks.label: AI Estate
blocks.meaning: AI models, prompts, evaluations and AI agents used by products and tooling.

blocks.label: Software Estate Measurement
blocks.meaning: Measurement of technical estate health, complexity, ownership and architecture conformance.

blocks.label: Source Change
blocks.meaning: Source-code changes proposed and reviewed for delivery.

blocks.label: Build & Verification
blocks.meaning: Build and test records proving that a change can work.

blocks.label: Release & Deployment
blocks.meaning: Change boundaries and deployment records.

blocks.label: Change Traceability
blocks.meaning: Records and metrics that connect delivered change to scope, evidence and outcomes.

blocks.label: Runtime Observation
blocks.meaning: Runtime entities and the telemetry used to observe them.

blocks.label: Incident & Problem Management
blocks.meaning: Operational disruptions, impact analysis and follow-up.

blocks.label: Reliability Management
blocks.meaning: Reliability objectives and service health state.

blocks.label: Operational Knowledge
blocks.meaning: Procedures used to run, diagnose and recover systems.

blocks.label: Rules & Expectations
blocks.meaning: Normative rules and expected practices.

blocks.label: Assurance & Evidence
blocks.meaning: Mechanisms for verifying and proving governance state.

blocks.label: Risk & Exceptions
blocks.meaning: Risks, approved deviations and risk acceptance choices.

blocks.label: Governance Decisions
blocks.meaning: Recorded choices with rationale, evidence and consequences.

blocks.label: Remediation & Measurement
blocks.meaning: Corrective actions and governance metrics.

blocks.label: Suppliers & Agreements
blocks.meaning: External suppliers and the agreements that govern supplier relationships.

blocks.label: Third-Party Assets & Services
blocks.meaning: External components, services and technology dependencies used by the organization.

blocks.label: Licenses & Obligations
blocks.meaning: Legal permissions and obligations on external components or assets the organization consumes. The outbound license for the organization's own Product is Product License (§3.5).

blocks.label: Supply-Chain Risk & Measurement
blocks.meaning: Risk and measurement around external components, services, vendors and licenses.

blocks.label: Work Management Layer
blocks.meaning: How does the organization organize work across all domains?

blocks.label: Function Overlay
blocks.meaning: Function Overlay — a cross-cutting layer that applies across all domains.

terms.label: Organization
terms.meaning: A software-producing company or group of companies being modeled.

terms.label: Legal Entity
terms.meaning: A legally recognized entity associated with the Organization.

terms.label: Organizational Unit
terms.meaning: Business unit, department, division or practice inside the Organization.

terms.label: Person
terms.meaning: A real human being known to the Organization.

terms.label: Employment
terms.meaning: Dated relationship between a Person and a Legal Entity.

terms.label: Competency
terms.meaning: Named capability, skill, expertise area or strength a Person can hold and a Position or Assignment can require — e.g., Kubernetes, payments domain expertise, incident command. Proficiency level and source (declared / assessed / derived) live on the possession record.

terms.label: Position
terms.meaning: Official role slot, title or function in the Organization.

terms.label: Reporting Line
terms.meaning: Dated manager/report relationship from one Position to another.

terms.label: Job Role
terms.meaning: Work/organizational role such as Product Manager, Developer, SRE or Security Lead. Held two ways: org-wide through a Position (Position implies Job Role), and per project through an Assignment (Assignment in_role Job Role, Work Management layer). So one person can hold several roles at once and act in a different role on each project — e.g. Tech Lead on one, Reviewer on another.

terms.label: Team
terms.meaning: A stable group of people that builds, owns, operates, supports or governs work/assets.

terms.label: Team Membership
terms.meaning: Dated membership of a Person in a Team.

terms.label: Position Allocation
terms.meaning: Dated allocation of a Position to a Team.

terms.label: Responsibility Assignment
terms.meaning: Dated record that a Person or Team is accountable for a domain object.

terms.label: Organizational Metric
terms.meaning: Measures teams, positions, employment, staffing, responsibility coverage or team health.

terms.label: Mission
terms.meaning: Timeless purpose: why the Organization exists. Grounds Vision and Strategy; not itself a future state (that is Vision) nor a way to win (that is Strategy).

terms.label: Vision
terms.meaning: Desired future state and product/business ambition. A Vision may set direction for the Organization (frames Strategy — vision above strategy) and/or for one or more Product Lines / Products (guided_by, §3.4). A Product or Line has at most one active Vision; one Vision may cover several Products / Lines.

terms.label: Strategy
terms.meaning: Durable direction: where the organization chooses to compete and how it intends to win.

terms.label: Objective
terms.meaning: Measurable outcome leadership wants to achieve.

terms.label: Objective Metric
terms.meaning: Measures progress toward objectives, initiatives or roadmap outcomes.

terms.label: Strategic Initiative
terms.meaning: Strategic investment theme or intent connecting Objectives to planned changes.

terms.label: Investment Direction
terms.meaning: Chosen direction for allocating funding, capacity or attention.

terms.label: Investment Metric
terms.meaning: Measures funding, capacity, spend, cost allocation or investment performance.

terms.label: Budget
terms.meaning: Approved funding envelope for a period and scope: organizational unit, strategic initiative, project or team.

terms.label: Spend Record
terms.meaning: Recorded actual cost: people, vendors, infrastructure, tooling or AI model usage.

terms.label: Roadmap
terms.meaning: Planning view over intended changes for a defined scope and horizon.

terms.label: Roadmap Item
terms.meaning: Planned outcome/change: feature, capability increment, experiment, compliance item, technical investment or market response.

terms.label: Roadmap Type
terms.meaning: Classification: company, product, platform, engineering, technology or governance.

terms.label: Roadmap Scope
terms.meaning: Domain object or area a Roadmap is about.

terms.label: Roadmap Horizon
terms.meaning: Planning time window: quarter, half-year, year or custom period.

terms.label: Business Decision
terms.meaning: Specialized Decision about investment, market, budget, pricing, partnership or priority.

terms.label: Market
terms.meaning: External arena in which the organization competes, sells, learns or seeks adoption.

terms.label: Market Segment
terms.meaning: Target market, customer group or context in which Products compete.

terms.label: Persona
terms.meaning: Representative user, buyer, customer or stakeholder type used to reason about needs and behavior; informs product, market and commercial decisions.

terms.label: Competitor
terms.meaning: Organization competing for the same customer need.

terms.label: Competitor Product
terms.meaning: Product offered by a Competitor.

terms.label: Competitor Feature
terms.meaning: Observed competitor capability, behavior, offer or change.

terms.label: Competitive Comparison
terms.meaning: Quarterly side-by-side comparison of competitors across functionality and company-scale dimensions.

terms.label: Pricing Benchmark
terms.meaning: Normalised benchmark of our pricing vs competitors per geography and tier, with trend.

terms.label: Market Signal
terms.meaning: Evidence from market, competitors, sales or customers that may influence product decisions.

terms.label: Customer Feedback
terms.meaning: Input from customers/users: support tickets, interviews, surveys, usage signals or sales feedback.

terms.label: Research Evidence
terms.meaning: Observed or collected evidence from research, analysis, interviews, experiments or market monitoring.

terms.label: Insight
terms.meaning: Interpreted learning from evidence that may influence strategy, product or commercial decisions.

terms.label: CEP Synthesis
terms.meaning: Periodic synthesis of customer-experience and usage findings into improvement input.

terms.label: Market Metric
terms.meaning: Measures market size, growth, share, demand, win/loss, competitor traction or segment behavior.

terms.label: Product Capability
terms.meaning: Stable ability of a Product to solve a coherent user or business scenario.

terms.label: Feature
terms.meaning: Product function or behavior available to a user or customer.

terms.label: Opportunity
terms.meaning: Product/market opportunity worth evaluating or pursuing.

terms.label: Hypothesis
terms.meaning: Testable belief about customer value, market response, usability, feasibility or business impact.

terms.label: Experiment
terms.meaning: Bounded activity to test a Hypothesis.

terms.label: Requirement
terms.meaning: Atomic statement of what a Product or System must do or satisfy.

terms.label: Acceptance Criteria
terms.meaning: Conditions that must be satisfied for a Requirement or Work Item to be accepted.

terms.label: Capability Increment
terms.meaning: Bounded change to a Feature or Product Capability.

terms.label: Design Artifact
terms.meaning: Design output specifying user experience or interface: wireframe, design prototype (mock, not running code), design specification.

terms.label: UI/UX Interactive PoC App
terms.meaning: Runnable proof-of-concept application in working code, built to validate a product experience; needs hosting and sharing, unlike a design prototype.

terms.label: PRD
terms.meaning: Product Requirements Document — authored spec packaging Requirements, actors and success criteria for a product change.

terms.label: DESIGN Document
terms.meaning: System/architecture design document: components, interfaces and constraints; references Architecture Decisions.

terms.label: Decomposition
terms.meaning: Ordered, dependency-linked FEATURE list derived from a DESIGN, with coverage back to Requirements.

terms.label: Feature Spec
terms.meaning: Implementable specification of a Feature: flows, algorithms, states and test scenarios.

terms.label: Impact/Coverage Report
terms.meaning: Analysis of which downstream artifacts and code a change affects, with coverage gaps and version-bump signal.

terms.label: Success Criteria
terms.meaning: Expected outcome condition for a change, expressed through metrics or qualitative evidence.

terms.label: Product Metric
terms.meaning: Measures product value, adoption, engagement, retention, usage, quality or outcome.

terms.label: EPSVS Scorecard
terms.meaning: Periodic scorecard across efficiency, performance, scalability, versatility and security dimensions.

terms.label: Customer
terms.meaning: Individual, group or organization receiving value from a Product; may be internal or external.

terms.label: User
terms.meaning: Person or system actor — including integrations and API clients — interacting with a Product or affected by its behavior.

terms.label: Product Decision
terms.meaning: Specialized Decision about product direction, scope, trade-off, roadmap or capability.

terms.label: Customer Account
terms.meaning: Commercial or organizational customer that buys, uses or evaluates a Product.

terms.label: Customer Agreement
terms.meaning: Agreement governing a commercial, legal or service relationship with a customer.

terms.label: Commercial Customer Relationship
terms.meaning: Ongoing relationship between the organization and a customer account across buying, usage, support and renewal.

terms.label: Deal
terms.meaning: Sales opportunity with a customer account, moving through pipeline stages toward an agreement.

terms.label: Win/Loss Record
terms.meaning: Recorded outcome and reasons of a closed deal.

terms.label: Commercial Plan
terms.meaning: Packaged commercial offer — often called a plan or tier — defining available capabilities, limits, pricing or service level.

terms.label: Pricing
terms.meaning: Rules or model for how product value is monetized.

terms.label: Entitlement
terms.meaning: Right granted to a customer, account or user to access a product capability, plan, limit or service.

terms.label: Product License
terms.meaning: Legal grant under which the organization's own Product is provided to a customer or the public: commercial license, EULA, or the product's own open-source license. Outbound counterpart of the inbound third-party License in §3.10.

terms.label: Subscription
terms.meaning: Ongoing commercial relationship granting access to a product, plan or service for a period.

terms.label: Renewal
terms.meaning: Commercial event or process of extending, changing or ending an existing customer relationship.

terms.label: SLA
terms.meaning: Agreement-backed service-level commitment to a customer.

terms.label: Support Case
terms.meaning: Tracked customer support request or issue with its own lifecycle and response commitments.

terms.label: Customer Health
terms.meaning: Assessed state of a customer relationship.

terms.label: Usage
terms.meaning: Measured product consumption, adoption or activity by customers or accounts.

terms.label: Commercial Metric
terms.meaning: Measures ARR, MRR, expansion, churn, usage revenue or agreement value.

terms.label: Software System
terms.meaning: Technical system that implements part of a Product or internal platform.

terms.label: Application
terms.meaning: User-facing or operator-facing deployable unit within or associated with a Software System.

terms.label: Service
terms.meaning: Deployable runtime unit exposing behavior to applications, systems or external consumers; includes serverless functions and scheduled jobs/workflows.

terms.label: API
terms.meaning: Interface specification through which systems, services or external consumers interact.

terms.label: Software Component
terms.meaning: Technical part of a Software System: module, adapter, deployable unit or infrastructure module. Consumed reusable packages are modeled as Library.

terms.label: Library
terms.meaning: Reusable code library or package consumed by applications, services or components; internal or third-party.

terms.label: Repository
terms.meaning: Source-control container for code, infrastructure, configuration or documentation.

terms.label: Code Area
terms.meaning: Logical area of code inside one or more Repositories.

terms.label: Documentation
terms.meaning: Authored documentation about a product, system or API, versioned in a Repository.

terms.label: Data Asset
terms.meaning: Dataset, schema, data product, event taxonomy or managed data resource.

terms.label: Instrumentation Plan
terms.meaning: Per-release plan of events, properties and triggers defining the event taxonomy captured to analytics.

terms.label: Infrastructure Resource
terms.meaning: Compute, network, storage, cloud, identity or platform resource used to run systems.

terms.label: Environment
terms.meaning: Runtime/deployment context such as dev, staging or production.

terms.label: Tooling System
terms.meaning: Software system used by the organization to plan, build, test, run, support or govern work; internally built or vendor-provided.

terms.label: Tool Workspace
terms.meaning: Collaboration or configuration container inside a specific Tooling System — a Slack workspace, Figma team, Notion workspace, Jira site or GitHub organization.

terms.label: Technology Stack
terms.meaning: Set of technologies, tooling systems, frameworks, languages and platforms used by the organization.

terms.label: AI Model
terms.meaning: AI/ML model used by products or tooling — vendor-provided or internally built; has versions.

terms.label: Prompt Asset
terms.meaning: Managed prompt, prompt template or agent instruction used with AI models; has versions.

terms.label: Eval Run
terms.meaning: Evaluation of an AI model, prompt or AI-backed feature against defined criteria.

terms.label: AI Agent
terms.meaning: Software actor that performs work using AI models under human accountability.

terms.label: Software Estate Metric
terms.meaning: Measures systems, applications, services, repositories, components, data assets, tooling or technology stack.

terms.label: Branch
terms.meaning: Line of development within a repository.

terms.label: Commit
terms.meaning: Versioned source-code change.

terms.label: Pull Request
terms.meaning: Proposed code change for review and merge.

terms.label: Code Review
terms.meaning: Review activity or record evaluating a Pull Request or code change before merge or release.

terms.label: Build
terms.meaning: Execution of a build for a source revision: status, logs, metadata and produced artifacts. The build definition is CI configuration versioned in a Repository (no separate term).

terms.label: Build Artifact
terms.meaning: Output of a build process: binary, container image, package or bundle.

terms.label: Test Case
terms.meaning: Test definition verifying behavior, requirement or quality condition.

terms.label: Test Run
terms.meaning: Execution of Test Cases.

terms.label: Release
terms.meaning: Planned or shipped change boundary with scope, version, decision, notes and rollout intent.

terms.label: Release Decision
terms.meaning: Specialized Decision for approving, rejecting or deferring a Release or Deployment.

terms.label: Deployment
terms.meaning: Event/record of placing a Build Artifact or Release into an Environment.

terms.label: Release Notes
terms.meaning: Human-readable summary of what a Release changes: features, fixes, breaking changes, upgrade notes.

terms.label: SBOM
terms.meaning: Machine-readable bill of materials: components, libraries and licenses contained in a Build Artifact or Release.

terms.label: Change Record
terms.meaning: Record connecting a delivered change to its scope, evidence, decision and deployment context.

terms.label: Delivery Metric
terms.meaning: Measures delivery flow, throughput, quality, lead time, release readiness or effectiveness.

terms.label: Runtime Instance
terms.meaning: Running instance of an Application, Service, job, database, queue, model endpoint or other runtime unit.

terms.label: Telemetry Signal
terms.meaning: Observed runtime signal: log, trace, metric, event or health check.

terms.label: Operational Metric
terms.meaning: Measures runtime, reliability, performance, availability or operational behavior.

terms.label: Alert
terms.meaning: Operational signal emitted by monitoring or observation.

terms.label: Incident
terms.meaning: Disruption or operational event requiring response and follow-up.

terms.label: Postmortem
terms.meaning: Analysis of an Incident and prevention actions.

terms.label: Customer Impact
terms.meaning: Effect of an operational event on Customers, Customer Accounts, revenue, commitments or usage.

terms.label: Problem
terms.meaning: Underlying or recurring cause behind incidents, defects or operational instability.

terms.label: SLO
terms.meaning: Internal measurable reliability or service-level objective.

terms.label: Service Health
terms.meaning: Current or historical view of whether a service is operating within expected thresholds.

terms.label: Runbook
terms.meaning: Operational procedure for running, diagnosing or recovering a system.

terms.label: Policy
terms.meaning: Normative organizational rule, expectation or requirement.

terms.label: Standard
terms.meaning: Required way of meeting a Policy or engineering/governance expectation — e.g., a reference architecture, coding or review standard.

terms.label: Guideline
terms.meaning: Recommended practice; not mandatory unless referenced by Policy/Standard.

terms.label: Control
terms.meaning: Verifiable mechanism that implements a Policy or reduces a Risk.

terms.label: Assessment
terms.meaning: Evaluation of an object, process or control against Policies, Standards or Risks.

terms.label: Finding
terms.meaning: Observed issue, gap, non-compliance, vulnerability or problem.

terms.label: Evidence
terms.meaning: Supporting or attesting artifact/record for a claim, control, decision, finding, risk or release.

terms.label: Review Findings Report
terms.meaning: Structured report packaging review Findings by severity and domain (code, design, ADR, PRD).

terms.label: Risk
terms.meaning: Possible negative event with likelihood, impact, owner and treatment status.

terms.label: Exception
terms.meaning: Approved deviation from Policy, Standard or Control, with scope and expiry.

terms.label: Risk Acceptance Decision
terms.meaning: Specialized Decision to accept a known risk under stated conditions.

terms.label: Decision
terms.meaning: General recorded choice with rationale, date, owner, evidence and consequences; base record for all specialized decisions.

terms.label: Architecture Decision
terms.meaning: Specialized Decision about technical architecture, system design or platform direction.

terms.label: Remediation
terms.meaning: Planned treatment to resolve a Finding or reduce a Risk.

terms.label: Governance Metric
terms.meaning: Measures risk exposure, control coverage, finding aging, exception volume or assessment status.

terms.label: Vendor
terms.meaning: Supplier outside the organization that provides tools, components, services, infrastructure or data.

terms.label: Supplier Agreement
terms.meaning: Agreement with a vendor, supplier, partner or external service provider.

terms.label: Third-Party Component
terms.meaning: Externally supplied component, package, service or dataset used by the organization. Externally consumed AI models are modeled as AI Model.

terms.label: External Service
terms.meaning: Service operated by an external party and used by the organization.

terms.label: Technology Dependency
terms.meaning: Dependency on a technology, framework, platform, runtime or standard outside direct product ownership.

terms.label: License
terms.meaning: Legal permission or constraint governing use, distribution, modification or commercialization of a third-party asset or component.

terms.label: License Obligation
terms.meaning: Requirement created by a License: attribution, notices, usage restriction, disclosure, payment or audit.

terms.label: Supply-Chain Risk
terms.meaning: Risk created by external components, vendors, services, licenses or delivery dependencies.

terms.label: External Dependency Metric
terms.meaning: Measures vendor performance, external service reliability, license exposure, component risk or dependency cost.

terms.label: Project
terms.meaning: Bounded execution effort: feature delivery, research, migration, complex bugfix, customer implementation or remediation.

terms.label: Workstream
terms.meaning: Coordinated stream of work inside or across Projects, often focused on a discipline, domain, system or outcome.

terms.label: Process
terms.meaning: Repeatable way of performing work or making decisions.

terms.label: Activity
terms.meaning: Bounded action or step within a process, project or workstream.

terms.label: Backlog
terms.meaning: Ordered or triaged collection of work that may be considered, planned or executed.

terms.label: Sprint
terms.meaning: Time-boxed execution iteration into which work items are planned (Scrum; other cadences map to Process).

terms.label: Work Item
terms.meaning: Tracked unit of delivery or follow-up work.

terms.label: Work Item Type
terms.meaning: Classification of a Work Item — epic, user story, task, bug, spike, chore, incident follow-up, remediation task.

terms.label: Assignment
terms.meaning: Allocation of work to a person, team, role or function; may carry the Job Role in which the assignee acts for this work; has effective dates when needed.

terms.label: Milestone
terms.meaning: Significant target date or achievement in a Project, Workstream or Roadmap.

terms.label: Dependency
terms.meaning: Relationship where one object, work item, team or external constraint affects another.

terms.label: Handoff
terms.meaning: Transfer of responsibility, context or work output between people, teams or functions.

terms.label: Outcome
terms.meaning: Result or effect the work is intended to create or has actually created.

terms.label: Product Management
terms.meaning: Strategy, Market, Product, Commercial, Work Management.

terms.label: R&D / Engineering
terms.meaning: Product, Software Estate, Delivery, Operations, Governance.

terms.label: Product Marketing
terms.meaning: Market, Product, Commercial, Strategy.

terms.label: Design / UX
terms.meaning: Product, Market, Delivery, Work Management.

terms.label: QA
terms.meaning: Product, Delivery, Software Estate, Governance.

terms.label: DevOps / SRE
terms.meaning: Software Estate, Delivery, Operations, Governance, External Dependencies.

terms.label: GTM / Sales
terms.meaning: Market, Commercial, Product, Strategy.

terms.label: Customer Success
terms.meaning: Commercial, Operations, Product, Market, Work Management.

terms.label: Security / Compliance
terms.meaning: Governance, Software Estate, Delivery, Operations, External Dependencies.

terms.label: People Ops
terms.meaning: Organizational Structure, Work Management, Governance.

terms.label: Finance
terms.meaning: Strategy, Commercial, External Dependencies, Governance.

terms.label: Legal
terms.meaning: Commercial, Governance, External Dependencies, Organizational Structure.

terms.label: Procurement
terms.meaning: External Dependencies, Commercial, Governance, Software Estate.

terms.label: Internal IT
terms.meaning: Organizational Structure, Software Estate, Operations, Governance, External Dependencies.

metaNodes.label: Domain Object
metaNodes.meaning: Generic scope: any managed object in the model — the shared target of ownership, governance and dependency links (has_owner, applies_to, blocks). Carries the accountability spine.

metaNodes.label: Function
metaNodes.meaning: Generic scope: any organizational function (Product Management, Engineering, QA, Sales, Security…) that staffs and takes part in work — the §5 Function Overlay (assigned_to, transfers_from/to).
